clauses.quoted_text:
4. Duties, Tariffs, and Refunds
Prices under this Agreement exclude customs duties and tariffs. Seller shall itemize on each invoice, as a
separate line designated "Tariff Surcharge", the actual duties paid by Seller on the products in that shipment,
and Buyer shall pay such surcharge together with the invoice. If Seller subsequently receives a refund,
drawback, or other recovery of any duty that was invoiced to Buyer as a Tariff Surcharge, Seller shall pass
through to Buyer the full amount of such refund attributable to Buyer's purchases, by credit memo or payment,
within thirty (30) days of Seller's receipt of the refund.
clauses.reasoning: Tariff language is present but creates neither a surcharge nor a refund obligation.
